verdict_scope: Audit baseline ready; not production security approval or finding remediation.

findings.attack_path: Unset or mistyped NOIE_AUTH_ENABLED selects the legacy unauthenticated dev-user path.
findings.existing_control: Strict JWT and ownership checks when enabled.
findings.impact: Authentication bypass and shared dev-user access if production is accidentally OFF.
findings.recommended_fix: Require an explicit environment mode and refuse unsafe production startup; preserve deliberate local dev mode.
findings.status: Confirmed code behavior; production exposure unverified

findings.attack_path: Read unencrypted AsyncStorage through compromised device, same-origin malicious script, or browser profile access.
findings.existing_control: Refresh coalescing, rotation and session race fences.
findings.gap: Persistent tokens are not in platform secure storage.
findings.likelihood: Conditional on local/device or same-origin compromise.
findings.impact: Bearer-session theft; refresh token can extend compromise.
findings.recommended_fix: Native Keychain/Keystore storage; separately design web session/XSS protections, not a blanket localStorage replacement.
findings.status: Confirmed storage design; no theft performed

findings.asset: Local chats, projects and daily traces
findings.attack_path: User A logs out, B signs in on the same installation; global NOIE keys are reloaded.
findings.existing_control: AuthGate blocks unauthenticated app access; session clearing is fenced.
findings.gap: NOIE data keys are not account-scoped and logout retains them.
findings.impact: B can see A's retained local data.
findings.recommended_fix: Namespace storage by verified stable account identity and define safe logout, migration and unassigned-data behavior.
findings.status: Confirmed design gap; no live personal-data experiment

findings.attack_path: A stolen token is reused after local session removal; verifier validates JWT claims but not server session liveness.
findings.existing_control: JWT signature, issuer, audience, expiry and anonymous-role checks.
findings.gap: Local logout does not revoke Supabase sessions; no session_id liveness policy.
findings.likelihood: Requires token theft; duration depends on provider settings.
findings.recommended_fix: Define provider logout scope, refresh revocation, acceptable JWT residual lifetime and optional sensitive-operation liveness checks.
findings.status: Confirmed missing application policy; live token lifetime unknown

findings.asset: API availability / OpenAI budget / DB capacity
findings.attack_path: Repeated chat, analysis, bootstrap or permitted action calls consume compute, model budget or rows.
findings.existing_control: Auth and ownership when ON; per-request idempotency; bounded action plans and attempt leases.
findings.gap: No application-level per-principal/IP quota or rate limiter found.
findings.likelihood: Authenticated abuse plausible; unauthenticated reach depends on auth mode and endpoint.
findings.impact: Service degradation, spend and storage exhaustion.
findings.recommended_fix: Add layered edge and application quotas, bounded concurrency and cost budgets; bootstrap-specific limits.
findings.status: Code gap confirmed; Render edge limits unknown

findings.attack_path: Huge chat text/history/project input or repeated full message/memory lists.
findings.existing_control: Pydantic types, some field limits and domain list bounds.
findings.gap: Several text/history fields lack upper bounds; core list APIs lack pagination.
findings.likelihood: Plausible with API access; edge body cap unknown.
findings.impact: Memory/CPU/model-token pressure and unnecessarily large private responses.
findings.recommended_fix: Bound bytes, strings, arrays and model budget; paginate core lists with stable ordering.
findings.evidence: backend/schemas.py: ChatRequest and analysis requests; chat_storage_service.py; memory_service.py

findings.attack_path: Provider error text or storage parse exceptions can include echoed input or credentials; background error logs include raw message IDs.
findings.existing_control: Many auth errors use safe labels; Shadow/chat_bg use hashed correlation.
findings.gap: Some raw exception strings/objects and UUIDs are still printed.
findings.likelihood: Conditional on exception contents and log access.
findings.impact: Potential private-data or secret disclosure; raw IDs increase linkability.
findings.recommended_fix: Use safe error classifications and hashed correlation; avoid raw exception/body logging and set log retention/access controls.
findings.evidence: backend/openai_analyzer.py: print_openai_error; backend/main.py project-combined catch; chat_agent_integration_service.py catch; mobile/src/noie/storage.ts; mobile/App.tsx
findings.status: Logging paths confirmed; actual secret/PII leak not observed

findings.attack_path: Any origin can make CORS-authorized browser requests if it can supply valid authority, or access dev-mode endpoints.
findings.gap: allow_origins, methods and headers use wildcard.
findings.likelihood: Conditional; CORS alone is not an auth bypass.
findings.impact: Broader browser exposure and weaker defense in depth.
findings.recommended_fix: Allowlist intended web origins with environment-specific policy; retain actual authorization.

findings.attack_path: Default /docs, /redoc and /openapi.json reveal API contracts; root/db-health are public.
findings.existing_control: Health executes SELECT 1 and returns no connection secrets; probe is gated.
findings.impact: Simplifies endpoint enumeration, not private-record access by itself.
findings.recommended_fix: Decide production documentation exposure and protect operational endpoints as needed without substituting for auth.
findings.evidence: backend/main.py: FastAPI constructor, root, db-health, internal probe
findings.status: Confirmed local app configuration; live routes not queried

findings.attack_path: Unsafe archive processing or vulnerable exposed dev-server middleware; not assumed present in static production assets.
findings.existing_control: Lockfile and explicit dependency tree are available.
findings.gap: npm audit reports affected Expo 48-era dependency entries including Critical and High.
findings.likelihood: Depends on affected tools being invoked/exposed and attacker-controlled inputs.
findings.impact: Build host compromise or development-server abuse; live app exploitability unproven.
findings.recommended_fix: Plan compatible Expo/toolchain upgrades and remove unused build paths after testing; do not use audit fix --force.
findings.evidence: mobile/package.json; mobile/package-lock.json; npm audit and npm explain
findings.status: Advisory/package presence confirmed; exploitability not tested

findings.attack_path: Deploy resolution differs from local versions; installed Starlette falls in selected advisory ranges.
findings.existing_control: Major bounds on SQLAlchemy/psycopg/Alembic; Supabase exact pin.
findings.gap: Most direct dependencies not locked; no comprehensive Python advisory scan.
findings.likelihood: Deployment variance plausible; reviewed advisory preconditions not demonstrated in NOIE.
findings.impact: Non-reproducible behavior and residual framework attack surface.
findings.recommended_fix: Create tested compatible lock strategy and full advisory inventory; review actual route/middleware preconditions.
findings.evidence: backend/requirements.txt; local installed distribution metadata; primary Starlette advisories
findings.status: Partial advisory review only; Render versions unknown

findings.attack_path: Soft delete hides rows but retains originals/evidence, backups and exported/provider data.
findings.existing_control: RESTRICT FKs deliberately protect originals; deleted users/resources checked.
findings.impact: Privacy obligations and user expectations may not be met.
findings.recommended_fix: Document retention and explicit verified purge workflow, backup expiry and third-party scope before implementing deletion.

findings.asset: AI context / memory integrity / tool authority
findings.attack_path: User or retrieved text asks model to invent records, override intent or select tools.
findings.existing_control: Ownership, evidence validation, typed schemas, registry/mode checks, confirmation, executor leases/fencing; current utterance priority.
findings.gap: Schema validity does not prove factuality or semantic safety.
findings.likelihood: Plausible within the attacker's own context; cross-user bypass not demonstrated.
findings.impact: Incorrect memories or domain records and unsafe recommendations; protected destructive authority remains a separate boundary.
findings.recommended_fix: Separate instruction/data trust, preserve evidence, add adversarial semantic tests and privacy tiers; never grant model authority.
findings.evidence: backend/agent/tool_policy.py; tool_registry.py; action_service.py; executor_service.py; memory services; recommendation context
findings.status: Residual model risk; no unauthorized execution observed

findings.attack_path: Weak DB role, missing transport/log controls, exposed build server or mismanaged secrets could defeat application defenses.
findings.existing_control: Environment-based credentials; .env files not tracked in current index; selected context minimization.
findings.gap: Live TLS, DB privileges/RLS, CSP, quotas, backup encryption/retention, secret history and provider settings not verified.
findings.impact: Potential severe impact if an operational control is absent.
findings.recommended_fix: Perform a scoped read-only operational checklist and dedicated secret/history scan without disclosing secret values.
findings.evidence: database.py; backend/mobile configuration; current git index checks
findings.status: Assurance gap, not a confirmed production vulnerability

existing_controls: JWT signature/claim verification when auth is ON
Immutable AuthPrincipal and active identity mapping
Refresh coalescing and session revision/generation fences
Original Message separate from Memory and Evidence
